description: This file defines the interface 'FileSystemApi' which specifies methods for file system operations such as selecting directories and files, reading files, creating directories and files, saving bytes or strings to files, and closing file streams.

methods.name: selectDirectory(): Promise<DirectoryHandle | FileSystemNoSelection> selectDirectory
methods.description: Prompts the user to select a directory, returning a DirectoryHandle or FileSystemNoSelection.

methods.name: selectFile(): Promise<FileHandleRead | FileSystemNoSelection> selectFile
methods.description: Prompts the user to select a file, returning a FileHandleRead or FileSystemNoSelection.

methods.name: readFile( readFile
methods.description: Reads data from a file and processes bytes with a callback, returning a FileSystemResult.

methods.name: createDirectory(parentDirectory: DirectoryHandle, name: string): Promise<DirectoryHandle | Fil/ createDirectory
methods.description: Creates a new directory within a parent DirectoryHandle, returning the new DirectoryHandle or FileSystemNoSelection.

methods.name: createFile(directory: DirectoryHandle, name: string): Promise<FileHandleReadWrite | FileSystem/ createFile
methods.description: Creates a new file within a directory, returning a FileHandleReadWrite or FileSystemNoSelection.

methods.name: saveBytes(file: FileHandleReadWrite, bytes: Uint8Array): Promise<'success' | 'failed'> saveBytes
methods.description: Saves bytes to a file, returning a success or failed status.

methods.name: saveString(file: FileHandleReadWrite, contents: string): Promise<'success' | 'failed'> saveString
methods.description: Saves a string content to a file, returning a success or failed status.

methods.name: closeFileWriteStream(file: FileHandleReadWrite): Promise<'success' | 'failed'> closeFileWriteStream
methods.description: Closes a file write stream, returning a success or failed status.

ctags.pattern: /^  createDirectory(parentDirectory: DirectoryHandle, name: string): Promise<DirectoryHandle | Fil/

ctags.name: createFile
ctags.pattern: /^  createFile(directory: DirectoryHandle, name: string): Promise<FileHandleReadWrite | FileSystem/
